content.short: European digital bank with accounts, cards and business variants.
content.description: N26 is a Berlin-based digital bank and one of Europe's most prominent neobanks, holding a full German banking licence and serving millions of customers across many European markets. Its mobile-first app offers current accounts with German IBANs, physical and virtual cards, sub-accounts (Spaces) for saving and budgeting, instant spending notifications, and tiered premium plans with travel and insurance perks, plus business accounts for freelancers and the self-employed. N26 also offers investing and crypto trading in some markets through partners, though its core is everyday banking. By pairing transparent, low-fee accounts with a polished app experience, N26 helped popularize app-based banking in Europe and continues to compete with both traditional banks and other digital challengers like Revolut and Monzo.
